message.description: Unsafe array destructuring of a tuple element with an error typed value.
message.help: The destructured value has type `error`, and this binding receives `error`. Use a safely typed source or narrow the value before destructuring it.

message.description: Unsafe assignment of an error typed value.
message.help: Assigned value has type `error`; the target has type `{ y: any; }`. Use a safely typed value or `unknown`, and narrow it before use.
